caseNameFull: JOHN Y. KEITH, IN ERROR v. E. A. CLARK, COLLECTOR OF STATE AND COUNTY REVENUE FOR MADISON COUNTY
headnotes: (S. C., 2 Leg. Rep., 234-243, and 97 U. S., 454 (L. ed., 24: 1071), where the dissenting opinions are also published.)

opinions.text: [See Keith v. Clark, 4 Lea, 718, where the decision of the supreme court of Tennessee is given after the case was remanded from the supreme court of the United States. Again before the supreme court of Tennessee in Clark v. Keith, 8 Lea, 703, and affirmed by the supreme court of the United States in 106 U. S., 464, 465 (L. ed., 27: 302). See on same question Marr v. State, 10 Lea, 470; Gaines v. Galbreath, 14 Lea, 359, 363, 364.]
